units.locator: Table 1, complete header and both rows

synthesis.question: Does a six-card window reduce examined candidates while retaining every target in the twelve constructed paired queries?
synthesis.approach: Compare full lookup of eighteen cards with windowed lookup of six cards on the same queries.
synthesis.result: Mean examined candidates decrease from eighteen to six, while hits decrease from twelve to eleven out of twelve.
synthesis.boundary: This fictional example measures candidate count, not runtime; a distant target is missed and no uncertainty or generalization is measured.

evidence.claim: Fewer examined candidates come with a loss of one target in this example.
evidence.interpretation: A local restriction creates a measurable tradeoff here; it does not establish universal speed or accuracy improvements.
evidence.limits: Twelve constructed queries, no measured runtime, no statistical inference, fictional data.
